svg.text: numpy 的两条真实报错（判定表与实验 1 逐字记录）：

text.font-family: Comic Sans MS, Comic Neue, Segoe Print, Kaiti SC, KaiTi, 楷体, cursive

svg.text: 推导口径：ValueError: shape mismatch: objects cannot be broadcast to a single shape. Mismatch is between arg 0 with shape (2, 3) and arg 1 with shape (4,).

text.font-family: Comic Sans MS, Comic Neue, Segoe Print, Kaiti SC, KaiTi, 楷体, cursive

svg.text: 执行口径：ValueError: operands could not be broadcast together with shapes (2,3) (4,) ——同一场失配，推导和执行各自报各自的。

text.font-family: Comic Sans MS, Comic Neue, Segoe Print, Kaiti SC, KaiTi, 楷体, cursive

svg.text: 要点：mini 与 numpy 的判定完全等价——右对齐补 1 后逐维三态；「(256,) 行而 (256,1) 不行」不是玄学，是第 1 维 1000 vs 256 失配。

text.font-family: Comic Sans MS, Comic Neue, Segoe Print, Kaiti SC, KaiTi, 楷体, cursive

svg.text: 实测环境：Linux aarch64 · Python 3.11.4 · numpy 1.26.4 · Ubuntu LLVM 18.1.8 · broadcast_lab 9/9 · test_broadcast 48/48
